description: This file defines dispatch function types, dispatch stubs, and utility functions related to convolution operations in the ATen/native namespace of PyTorch, including backend selection, memory format suggestions, and shape checks.

methods.name: select_conv_backend
methods.description: Selects the convolution backend based on input tensors and parameters.

methods.name: _determine_backend_memory_format
methods.description: Determines the appropriate memory format for the backend based on input tensors and backend type.

methods.name: check_args
methods.description: Checks that convolution parameters like padding, stride, and dilation are valid.

methods.name: convolution_shape_check
methods.description: Performs shape validation for convolution input, weight, and output tensors.

methods.name: _conv_output_size
methods.description: Calculates the output size of a convolution given input size, weight size, padding, stride, and dilation.

methods.name: conv_output_size
methods.description: Overloaded functions to compute convolution output size for different tensor size representations.

methods.name: conv_input_size
methods.description: Calculates the input size needed for a convolution given output size, weight size, padding, output padding, stride, and dilation.

methods.name: conv_weight_size
methods.description: Calculates the weight tensor size for a convolution based on input and output sizes, padding, output padding, stride, dilation, and groups.

methods.name: reshape_bias
methods.description: Reshapes the bias tensor to match the specified dimension.

methods.name: cudnn_conv_suggest_memory_format
methods.description: Suggests the best memory format for cuDNN convolution based on input and weight tensors.

methods.name: miopen_conv_suggest_memory_format
methods.description: Suggests the best memory format for MIOpen convolution based on input and weight tensors.

methods.name: miopen_conv_use_channels_last
methods.description: Checks if MIOpen convolution should use channels last format (deprecated).

methods.name: mkldnn_conv_use_channels_last
methods.description: Checks if MKLDNN convolution should use channels last format.

methods.name: thnn_conv_use_channels_last
methods.description: Checks if THNN convolution should use channels last format.

methods.name: xpu_conv_use_channels_last
methods.description: Checks if XPU convolution should use channels last format.

methods.name: mps_conv_use_channels_last
methods.description: Checks if MPS convolution should use channels last format.
